He played college basketball for [[Clemson University]]. ==College career== Grantham competed for the [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson Tigers]], averaging 8.8 points per game as a freshman and 10.2 points per game as a sophomore. His scoring fell to 7.3 points per game as a junior.{{cite news |title=Gramlich: Grantham will overcome injury |url=https://www.independentmail.com/story/sports/college/clemson/basketball/2018/01/30/gramlich-clemsons-donte-granthams-maturity-enough-overcome-injury-adversity/1071206001/ |accessdate=December 5, 2019 |work=[[The Independent-Mail]] |date=January 30, 2018}} He averaged 14.2 points and 6.9 rebounds per game as a senior. Grantham suffered a torn ACL in a game against [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball|Notre Dame]] on January 21, 2018, prematurely ending his college career.{{cite news |title=Tigers senior Donte Grantham tears ACL, ending Clemson career |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22169610/donte-grantham-clemson-tigers-rest-year-torn-acl |accessdate=December 5, 2019 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=January 21, 2018}} ==Professional career== ===Oklahoma City Blue (2018)=== After going undrafted in the [[2018 NBA draft]], Grantham signed with the Oklahoma City Thunder on October 10, 2018.{{cite web|title=Thunder Signs Grantham, Hopson and Wells |url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/release-roster-181010|date=October 10, 2018|website=NBA.com|accessdate=October 10, 2018}} but was later waived two days later.{{cite web|title=Thunder Waives Four|url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/roster-181012|date=October 12, 2018|website=NBA.com|accessdate=October 13, 2018}} Grantham was later included in the training camp roster of the [[Oklahoma City Blue]].{{cite web|title=Oklahoma City Blue Announces Training Camp Roster|url=https://oklahomacity.gleague.nba.com/news/oklahoma-city-blue-announces-training-camp-roster-3|date=October 23, 2018|website=NBA.com|accessdate=October 23, 2018}} ===Oklahoma City Thunder (2018–2019)=== After beginning his professional career with the [[Oklahoma City Blue]] of the [[NBA G League]], Grantham was signed to a [[two-way contract]] by the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] on December 28, 2018.{{cite web|first=|last=|url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/grantham-181228|title=Thunder Signs Donte Grantham to Two-Way Contract|work=nba.com|date=December 28, 2018|accessdate=December 30, 2018}} Grantham made his NBA debut with the Thunder on February 7, 2019, playing in only two minutes of action under a blowout 117–95 win over the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore/_/id/401071488|title = Grizzlies vs. Thunder – Box Score – February 7, 2019 – ESPN}} On July 25, 2019, Grantham was waived by the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/grantham-190725|title=Thunder Waives Donte Grantham|date=July 25, 2019|work=NBA.com|accessdate=July 25, 2019}} ===Agua Caliente Clippers (2019–2021)=== On August 28, 2019, Grantham signed an Exhibit 10 contract with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]].{{cite news |title=Clippers' Donte Grantham: Inks Exhibit 10 with Clippers |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/clippers-donte-grantham-inks-exhibit-10-with-clippers/ |accessdate=May 25, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=August 28, 2019}} For the 2019–20 season, Grantham joined the [[Agua Caliente Clippers]] of the G League.{{cite web |title=AGUA CALIENTE CLIPPERS FINALIZE OPENING NIGHT ROSTER |url=https://aguacaliente.gleague.nba.com/agua-caliente-clippers-finalize-opening-night-roster/ |website=NBA.com |accessdate=December 5, 2019}} On December 15, Grantham posted 25 points, nine rebounds, two assists and a steal in a loss to the [[Santa Cruz Warriors]].{{cite news |title=Donte Grantham: Paces team in win |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/donte-grantham-paces-team-in-win/ |accessdate=May 25, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=December 16, 2019}} ===Champagne Châlons-Reims
